# Decision log

Status: draft until each decider confirms their entries
Append-only. Never edit or delete an entry. A correction is a new entry that cites and supersedes the old one.
Approver role: <artifact owner, name blank until signed>

## Entries

The ID is in the first column and the topic in the second.

```
| ID | Topic | Decision (in the decider's words) | Decider role | Date | Reason (stated by the decider) | Options considered and rejected, with reasons | Story, job or pain point IDs | Evidence IDs | Principle IDs | Affects | Supersedes | Confirmed by the decider |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <DL-NNN> | <topic> | <decision> | <role> | <YYYY-MM-DD> | <reason, or To verify> | <options, or To verify> | <IDs, or none exist> | <IDs> | <EP-NN> | <screen, component or artifact IDs> | <DL-NNN, or none> | <yes or no> |
```

## Foundation rule entries

One entry for each rule in language/foundations.md. Topic: the rule ID and a short name. Reason: stated by the decider. Principle: the principle the rule serves.

## Screen entries

One entry for each screen in screens/screen-plan.md. Topic: the screen ID and name. Story, evidence and principle IDs come from the screen plan. A screen with none is listed under Gaps, not filled in.

## Evidence

| Item ID | Claim | Source | Evidence tag | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <ID> | <claim> | <source> | <Evidence, Inference or Assumption> | <High, Medium or Low, with one phrase why> |

## Gaps and open questions
- <Entries with no decider, date, reason or cited ID. Screens with no story, evidence or principle. Entries that changed a prior one with no superseding entry.>

## Not checked
- <List what this log did not verify.>
